# Dogfood And Retire The Archive

Authored Intent's own intent.yaml via the write CLI, committed the generated docs, deleted archive/, and rewrote README.md to describe the Go CLI instead of the retired Agent Skill. Also fixed add/record's repeatable flags (mitigates, fulfills, acceptance, affects, option, consequence) to stop silently splitting values on commas.

**Rationale:**

The repo shipped a tool that could describe a product and engineering tree in its own format, but didn't use that format to describe itself -- a new adopter had no example to read. Dogfooding also surfaced a real CLI bug: pflag's StringSliceVar splits a value on commas even within one flag occurrence, which was silently shredding decision-record options and consequences into fragments.
